tool_schemas.name: sendBulkMail
tool_schemas.description: Creates a bulk outbound send job for the specified mail account using the provided bulk_payload (and optional to/cc/bcc, template, bodies, attachments, and scheduled_for), returning the created job record with its job ID and initial status (queued/scheduled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, email addresses are malformed, scheduled_for is not a valid future timestamp, or the job has no resolvable recipients from bulk_payload/to; raises NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or related_in_reply_to_email_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to send from the account, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if send/job limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the reply linkage is invalid for the account/message (e.g., message not in that account) or the job cannot be created due to current provider/account state.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to send from.

from_email.description: Override the From email address (defaults to the account).

from_name.description: Override the From display name (defaults to the account).

template.description: Template identifier/name used for bulk rendering (if supported).

body_text.description: Plain-text body content (used when sending text or multipart).

body_html.description: HTML body content (used when sending HTML or multipart).

attachment_refs.description: Attachment references/handles to include with the send job.

bulk_payload.description: Bulk send payload (provider-specific), e.g., per-recipient personalization and recipient lists.

to.description: Primary recipients for the bulk job (may be used when bulk_payload does not define recipients).

cc.description: CC recipients for the bulk job.

bcc.description: BCC recipients for the bulk job.

scheduled_for.description: Schedule the bulk job for a future time instead of sending immediately.

related_in_reply_to_email_id.description: If sending as a reply, link this job to the existing email message ULID.

tool_schemas.name: sendMail
tool_schemas.description: Sends a single outbound email from the specified mail account (immediately or at scheduled_for) with optional HTML and/or text bodies and attachments, returning a send job record with its job ID and initial status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if recipients are missing/invalid, subject is missing, scheduled_for is invalid, or attachment_refs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or related_in_reply_to_email_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot send from the account, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if send limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the message cannot be queued/scheduled due to the account/provider state or an invalid reply association.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to send from.

from_email.description: Override the From email address (defaults to the account).

from_name.description: Override the From display name (defaults to the account).

scheduled_for.description: Schedule send for a future time instead of sending immediately.

related_in_reply_to_email_id.description: If sending as a reply, link to the existing email message ULID.

tool_schemas.name: sendSimpleMail
tool_schemas.description: Sends a single outbound plain-text email (body_text) from the specified mail account (immediately or at scheduled_for) with optional attachments, returning a send job record with its job ID and initial status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body_text/subject/to are missing, any recipient address is invalid, scheduled_for is invalid, or attachment_refs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or related_in_reply_to_email_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot send from the account, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if send limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the message cannot be queued/scheduled due to the account/provider state or an invalid reply association.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to send from.

from_email.description: Override the From email address (defaults to the account).

from_name.description: Override the From display name (defaults to the account).

scheduled_for.description: Schedule send for a future time instead of sending immediately.

related_in_reply_to_email_id.description: If sending as a reply, link to the existing email message ULID.

tool_schemas.name: sendHtmlMail
tool_schemas.description: Sends a single outbound HTML email (body_html) from the specified mail account (immediately or at scheduled_for), optionally including a plain-text alternative (body_text) and attachments, returning a send job record with its job ID and initial status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if body_html/subject/to are missing, any recipient address is invalid, scheduled_for is invalid, or attachment_refs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or related_in_reply_to_email_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot send from the account, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if send limits are exceeded, and CONFLICT if the message cannot be queued/scheduled due to the account/provider state or an invalid reply association.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to send from.

from_email.description: Override the From email address (defaults to the account).

from_name.description: Override the From display name (defaults to the account).

scheduled_for.description: Schedule send for a future time instead of sending immediately.

related_in_reply_to_email_id.description: If sending as a reply, link to the existing email message ULID.

tool_schemas.name: waitForReply
tool_schemas.description: Polls the specified mail account for an inbound reply to in_reply_to_email_id (optionally scoped by thread_id) until a reply is found or timeout_seconds elapses, returning the matched reply message record when found (and marking it read if mark_as_read is true). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if timeout_seconds or poll_interval_seconds are < 1, or if thread_id is provided in an unsupported/invalid format; raises NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or in_reply_to_email_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account, CONFLICT if the original message cannot be used for reply matching (e.g., not in the account or missing required threading metadata), and TIMEOUT if no matching reply arrives before the timeout.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to monitor for a reply.

in_reply_to_email_id.description: The original email message ULID to wait for replies to.

thread_id.description: Optional provider thread identifier to scope the reply search.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait before giving up.

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often to poll for new messages while waiting.

mark_as_read.description: Whether to mark the detected reply as read when found.

tool_schemas.name: searchEmails
tool_schemas.description: Searches messages within a mail account using free-text query and optional filters (folder_id, thread_id, direction, is_read, has_attachments, and received/sent time windows) and returns a paged list of matching message summaries. Results are paginated; the response includes items plus pagination metadata (e.g., limit/offset or cursor/next_cursor) to fetch subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter combinations or timestamps (e.g., received_after > received_before), NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id or folder_id does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the account, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if search rate/usage limits are exceeded.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to search within.

query.description: Free-text query to search across common fields (subject, from, recipients, snippet/body).

folder_id.description: Restrict results to a specific folder ULID.

thread_id.description: Restrict results to a specific thread identifier.

has_attachments.description: Restrict results to messages with/without attachments.

received_after.description: Only include messages received after this timestamp.

received_before.description: Only include messages received before this timestamp.

sent_after.description: Only include messages sent after this timestamp.

sent_before.description: Only include messages sent before this timestamp.

status.description: Restrict results by local message status.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: listEmails
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to list messages for.

folder_id.description: Restrict results to a specific folder ULID.

has_attachments.description: Restrict results to messages with/without attachments.

status.description: Restrict results by local message status.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getContacts
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ULID to list contacts for.

query.description: Optional free-text filter on email address or display name.

limit.description: Maximum number of contacts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getEmailDetail
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

email_id.description: ID of the email message to fetch (mail_msg_* ULID).

tool_schemas.name: deleteEmail
tool_schemas.description: Description not available

email_id.description: ID of the email message to delete (mail_msg_* ULID).

hard_delete.description: If true, permanently purge the message; if false, perform a soft delete (move to deleted state).

tool_schemas.name: moveEmail
tool_schemas.description: Moves a single email message into the specified destination folder and returns the updated message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either ID is missing/doesn’t match the required pattern, NOT_FOUND if the email_id or destination_folder_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the message or folder. Raises CONFLICT if the move is not allowed due to the message/folder state (for example, attempting to move a deleted message or into a deleted folder).

email_id.description: ID of the email message to move (mail_msg_* ULID).

destination_folder_id.description: Folder ID to move the message into (mail_fldr_* ULID).

tool_schemas.name: getAttachment
tool_schemas.description: Fetches an email attachment by attachment_id and returns the attachment metadata and content. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if attachment_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the attachment does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the attachment via its owning message/account. Raises CONFLICT if the attachment is no longer available due to the owning message being deleted or otherwise not retrievable.

attachment_id.description: ID of the attachment to fetch (mail_att_* ULID).

tool_schemas.name: listFolders
tool_schemas.description: Lists folders for a mail account and returns a page of folder records plus a next cursor when more results are available; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page, and omit cursor to start from the first page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter/sort values or if limit is outside 1–200, NOT_FOUND if mail_account_id (or parent_folder_id when provided) does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the specified account. Raises CONFLICT if the requested combination of filters is not applicable to the account’s current state (for example, listing folders for a deleted account).

mail_account_id.description: Mail account to list folders for (mail_acct_* ULID).

parent_folder_id.description: Filter to folders whose parent is this folder (mail_fldr_* ULID).

limit.description: Maximum number of folders to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: markMultipleAsRead
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified set of email messages as read and returns the updated messages (or an acknowledgement of the update). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email_ids is empty or any ID is invalid, NOT_FOUND if any referenced message does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to one or more messages. Raises CONFLICT if one or more messages cannot be updated due to their current state (for example, deleted or immutable messages).

email_ids.description: List of email message IDs to mark as read (mail_msg_* ULIDs).

tool_schemas.name: markMultipleAsUnread
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified set of email messages as unread and returns the updated messages (or an acknowledgement of the update). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email_ids is empty or any ID is invalid, NOT_FOUND if any referenced message does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to one or more messages. Raises CONFLICT if one or more messages cannot be updated due to their current state (for example, deleted or immutable messages).

email_ids.description: List of email message IDs to mark as unread (mail_msg_* ULIDs).

tool_schemas.name: markAsRead
tool_schemas.description: Marks a single email message as read and returns the updated message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email_id is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the message. Raises CONFLICT if the message cannot be updated due to its current state (for example, deleted or immutable).

email_id.description: ID of the email message to mark as read (mail_msg_* ULID).

tool_schemas.name: markAsUnread
tool_schemas.description: Marks a single email message as unread and returns the updated message record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if email_id is missing/invalid or if mail_account_id is provided but invalid, NOT_FOUND if the message does not exist (or if a provided mail_account_id does not exist), and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the message/account. Raises CONFLICT if the message cannot be updated due to its current state or if a provided mail_account_id does not match the message’s owning account.

email_id.description: ID of the email message to mark as unread.

mail_account_id.description: Mail account ID owning the message (used for scoping/verification).

tool_schemas.name: listMailAccounts
tool_schemas.description: Lists mail accounts visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/provider/email_address. Returns a paginated array of mail_accounts records. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters or pagination.

status.description: Filter by one or more account statuses.

provider.description: Filter by one or more providers.

email_address.description: Filter by exact email address (case-insensitive match may be applied).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: getMailAccount
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single mail_accounts record by id. Returns the mail account if it exists and is visible to the caller; raises NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not accessible.

tool_schemas.name: updateMailAccount
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a mail account, including lifecycle transitions via status. Returns the updated mail_accounts record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if attempting an invalid status transition, or if host/port values are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the account does not exist or is not accessible.

default_from_name.description: Default From display name used when sending.

status.description: Set the account lifecycle status (must follow allowed transitions).
